opts: Replaces routine AND professional work like legal research and diagnosis

questions.text: What are "T-shaped skills"?
opts: Skills that are broad but never deep
Deep expertise in one area + breadth across others
Skills that take 10 years to develop
questions.correct: Deep expertise in one area + breadth across others
questions.hint: "Go deep in one area... But also build breadth — learn to communicate, to understand other fields."

questions.text: What surprised Amir most about his internship?
opts: He was given real work on day two, not a gentle introduction
questions.correct: He was given real work on day two, not a gentle introduction
questions.hint: "Instead, on day two, I was assigned to a team... handed a codebase I had never seen."

questions.text: The first reading says adaptability is the best career preparation.
questions.hint: "The best preparation is not to predict which profession will survive — it is to become a person who can adapt."

questions.text: Amir's feedback said his work was "good enough for ___ ."
questions.hint: "Good enough for production" — the highest praise a junior developer can receive.

questions.text: What does Amir say is his one piece of advice for new interns?

questions.correct: Go in with no expectations; be ready to be surprised
questions.hint: "Go in with no expectations, and be ready to be surprised — in every direction."

questions.text: Present Perfect Continuous is formed with:
questions.hint: have/has + been + -ing = Present Perfect Continuous. ✅

questions.text: "I've been studying FOR ___." What fits?
questions.hint: FOR + duration (three months). SINCE + starting point (2021 / Monday). ✅

questions.text: "She ___ (know) him since school." Correct form:
questions.hint: "know" = stative verb → Simple. "She HAS KNOWN him since school." ✅ Never "been knowing."

questions.text: "She applied ___ the internship and got it."
questions.hint: "apply FOR a job/internship/position." ✅ Always "for."

questions.text: "She's been ___ a lot of progress this month."
questions.hint: "MAKE progress." ✅ Never "do progress."

questions.text: "He ___ an internship at DataBridge." Choose.
questions.hint: "DO an internship." ✅ (he is doing it right now).

questions.text: "She ___ (prepare) for the interview for months." (PPC)
questions.hint: Duration → Present Perfect Continuous. "She HAS BEEN PREPARING for months." ✅

questions.text: "He ___ notes in every meeting." Choose.
questions.hint: "TAKE notes." ✅ Always "take" with notes.

questions.text: "Develop genuine expertise." "Expertise" means:
opts: High level of skill in a specific field
questions.correct: High level of skill in a specific field
questions.hint: "expertise" = deep mastery in a domain.

questions.text: "She showed real initiative." "Initiative" means:
questions.hint: "initiative" = proactively doing things; not waiting to be told.

questions.text: "Code that is good enough for production." "Production" (in tech) means:
opts: The live system used by real users
questions.correct: The live system used by real users
questions.hint: "production" in tech = the live, real system that actual users interact with.

questions.text: "The message is nuanced." "Nuanced" means:
questions.hint: "nuanced" = not black and white; showing fine, subtle distinctions.

questions.text: "She is adaptable." "Adaptable" means:
opts: Able to change and adjust to new situations
questions.correct: Able to change and adjust to new situations
questions.hint: "adaptable" = flexible; able to adjust to changing circumstances.
